title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00078 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Performed TBT prior to POOH
00:15 - 02:15: POOH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 841 m to 40 m. Pulled wet. Avg. Tripping speed 400 m/hr.
02:15 - 02:30: Flowchecked well for 15 min prior to pulling BHA through BOP. Meanwhile removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing
02:30 - 02:45: POOH to surface
02:45 - 03:00: L/d cutter BHA
03:00 - 03:30: P/u and m/u the 13 3/8" EZSV plug BHA
03:30 - 05:30: RIH w/ 13 3/8" EZSV on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 820 m Avg. Tripping speed 370 m/hr.
05:30 - 05:45: M/u TDS and filled pipe
05:45 - 06:30: Established circulation and washed the setting area from 830 mmd to 825 mmd. Measured 5ppm h2s in gas trap. Installed the 13 3/8" EZSV plug at 827 m.
06:30 - 06:45: Disconnected TDS and dropped 3 1/5" drift with tail
06:45 - 07:30: POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 807 m to 42 m. Avg. Tripping speed 1000 m/hr.
07:30 - 07:45: Retrieved drift. Removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing.
07:45 - 08:15: L/d the 13 3/8" EZSV plug RT.
08:15 - 08:30: Performed TBT for pressure testing EZSV plug.
08:30 - 10:30: Attempted to pressure test 13 3/8" EZSV plug to 40bar/10min. Volume pumped higher than estimated. Estmiated volume to pressure up from 10 to 40 bar 100 ltr. Investigated for surface leakage, no findings.
10:30 - 10:45: Performed TBT prior to RIH and pressure test EZSV plug from below.
10:45 - 11:15: P/u and m/u 13 3/8" EZSV RT to 5 1/2" HWDP removed masterbushing and installed PS-21 slips.
11:15 - 12:00: RIH from surface to 78 mmd on 5 1/2" HWDP. Re-arranged pipe in derrick to reach last HWDP.
12:00 - 13:15: RIH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 78 m to 827 m. Avg tripping speed 600m/hr.
13:15 - 13:45: Stung into the EZSV plug, set down 10 ton. Performed TBT for pressure testing 13 3/8" EZSV from below.
13:45 - 14:30: Closed annular and pressure tested EZSV plug from below to 14 bar. Volume pumped 1100 ltr, bled back 900 ltr. Observed pressure increaseing on choke gauge. Opened annular and released RT

sections.text: Performed TBT prior to POOH
POOH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 841 m to 40 m. Pulled wet. Avg. Tripping speed 400 m/hr.
Flowchecked well for 15 min prior to pulling BHA through BOP. Meanwhile removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing
POOH to surface
L/d cutter BHA
P/u and m/u the 13 3/8" EZSV plug BHA
RIH w/ 13 3/8" EZSV on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 820 m Avg. Tripping speed 370 m/hr.
M/u TDS and filled pipe
Established circulation and washed the setting area from 830 mmd to 825 mmd. Measured 5ppm h2s in gas trap. Installed the 13 3/8" EZSV plug at 827 m.
Disconnected TDS and dropped 3 1/5" drift with tail
POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 807 m to 42 m. Avg. Tripping speed 1000 m/hr.
Retrieved drift. Removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing.
L/d the 13 3/8" EZSV plug RT.
Performed TBT for pressure testing EZSV plug.

Attempted to pressure test 13 3/8" EZSV plug to 40bar/10min. Volume pumped higher than estimated. Estmiated volume to pressure up from 10 to 40 bar 100 ltr. Investigated for surface leakage, no findings.
Performed TBT prior to RIH and pressure test EZSV plug from below.
P/u and m/u 13 3/8" EZSV RT to 5 1/2" HWDP removed masterbushing and installed PS-21 slips.
RIH from surface to 78 mmd on 5 1/2" HWDP. Re-arranged pipe in derrick to reach last HWDP.
RIH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 78 m to 827 m. Avg tripping speed 600m/hr.
Stung into the EZSV plug, set down 10 ton. Performed TBT for pressure testing 13 3/8" EZSV from below.
Closed annular and pressure tested EZSV plug from below to 14 bar. Volume pumped 1100 ltr, bled back 900 ltr. Observed pressure increaseing on choke gauge. Opened annular and released RT.
POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 827 m to 681 m. VFD fault on FWD PRS.
Troubleshoot and started repairing FWD PRS.
Continued troubleshooting and repairing FWD PRS
Continued POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 681 m to 116 m Avg. Tripping speed 750 m/hr.
Flowchecked well, static. Meanwhile removed PS-21 slips and installed masterbushing.
POOH with EZSV RT on 5 1/2" HWDP from 116 mmd to surface.
M/u lift sub and pulled EZSV RT to surface. B/o and l/d XO for next run. L/d RT
Performed TBT for m/u new cutter BHA
P/u old cutter assy, b/o and l/d float sub. L/d cutter assy. P/u new cutter assy and m/u to string magnet and XO. M/u float sub and XO.
